editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Pepperstone is a legit, FCA/ASIC/CySEC-regulated ECN broker with 16 years of operation and the strongest regulatory coverage of any raw-spread broker globally — seven licences across four continents. The Razor account on cTrader delivers 0.0-0.2 pip EUR/USD spreads with $6 round-turn commission, and the direct FCA licence means UK clients get FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 — something no other top-tier ECN can match in 2026. Trustpilot sits at 4.4/5 from 3,000+ reviews with 81% five-star ratings, and withdrawals process in 1-2 business days with zero fees from Pepperstone's side. The ownership litigation — Lock's FX Group Holdings ordered to pay A$96.9 million following a buyout dispute — is a transparency concern worth monitoring but is unrelated to client funds or regulatory standing. No minimum deposit and five platform choices including spread betting for UK make this one of the most accessible institutional-grade brokers available. A serious execution broker for traders who value regulatory depth and UK protection alongside competitive pricing.
